# Yakkyofy Demo

> A full-stack e-commerce portfolio project by Saoshyant Mansouri — a Vue storefront backed by
> Node.js, MongoDB, and a RabbitMQ order pipeline, with real Stripe and PayPal integrations
> running against their sandbox APIs. The architecture is modeled after Yakkyofy, an
> e-commerce sourcing platform.

This is a demonstration application, not a production store. Mock product catalogue,
sandbox-only payments, no real transactions. It exists to show a complete, working checkout
flow — authentication, a real product catalogue, cart and order state, and two payment
providers integrated end to end — rather than a static mockup.

## Author

- [Saoshyant Mansouri](https://www.mhdmansouri.com/): the author of this project. Full-stack
  engineer; see the site for other work.

## Pages

- [Home](/): project overview and links.
- [System design](/system-design): architecture diagram, database schema, and API reference
  for this application.

## Stack

Vue 2.7, Vuex, Vue Router, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP — Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose),
RabbitMQ (amqplib) — Stripe, PayPal REST API — deployed on Vercel (frontend) and Azure
Container Apps (API/worker), MongoDB Atlas, and CloudAMQP.
